description: This file implements a Common Subexpression Elimination (CSE) pass for torch.fx graphs, including classes and functions for identifying and eliminating duplicate subgraphs, with specific handling for stateful operations and dialect compatibility.

classes.name: CSEPass
classes.description: A class implementing a dialect-agnostic common subexpression elimination pass for torch.fx graphs, with customizable banned operations.

methods.name: get_CSE_banned_ops
methods.description: Returns a set of operations (random and inplace ops) that are banned from CSE due to statefulness.

methods.name: CSEPass.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the CSEPass with an optional set of banned operations.

methods.name: CSEPass.call
methods.description: Performs CSE on a given GraphModule, returning a new GraphModule with duplicates eliminated and a flag indicating if modifications occurred.
